messages:
maddie: Heads-up — Acme POC (next week) hit a blocker: customer requires we use their KMS and wants explicit CAIQ answers about key ownership, rotation, and audit log access. Link to questionnaire: https://acme.example/CAIQ
kevin: Quick clarifying q: do they insist on Private deployment or would Hosted with VPC peering be acceptable? That changes what logs/keys we can provide. :thinking:
olivia: They wrote "customer-managed KMS" in the brief. If we run Hosted the customer retains master keys; Redwood can provide runtime/audit metadata only. I'll draft CAIQ responses for the key-management controls (K9-K12) and the evidence list (diagram + SOC2).
zach: Pricing note: if they require Dedicated for predictable latency we should quote a short-term reserved capacity for the POC (2 weeks). Hosted bursts could cost more for sustained throughput. I'll assemble a 2-week Dedicated estimate and post by EOD.
kevin: For the CAIQ evidence, can we agree on a short ownership table we can paste into the questionnaire? Suggestion:
```
Control | KMS ownership | Logging responsibility | Evidence
------------------------------------------------------
Key generation | Customer | Customer | KMS key ARN + policy
Key rotation | Customer | Customer | Rotation schedule + KMS logs
At-rest encryption (model cache) | Redwood | Redwood | Runtime encryption notes
Long-term model artifacts | Customer | Customer | Storage ACLs + encryption config
```
olivia: One tweak: mark "At-rest encryption (model cache)" as Redwood for ephemeral caches, but shared for persisted artifacts. I'll craft a one-paragraph explanation to paste under the CAIQ free-text fields. @maddie please confirm POC kickoff date.
maddie: POC kickoff = 2026-04-01, duration 2 weeks. Olivia — please upload CAIQ answers + network diagram by 2026-03-27 so security can review before kickoff. Zach — quote due EOD today. Kevin — drop the ownership table in the customer repo and link it in the questionnaire. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 report link and any pen-test summary to the evidence section before marking the questionnaire complete.
kevin: Got it. Olivia, if you want a sanitized log sample for the audit log field I can generate one from staging and scrub PII.
olivia: Yes please, that helps. Thanks — I'll take the CAIQ draft and upload.
